title: On Energy Stocks As A Portfolio Diversifier

On Energy Stocks As A Portfolio Diversifier

Louis-Vincent Gave

Gavekal Research | 11 Sep 2026

Over the past five years, energy has been the best performing sector in the S&P 500, and in the MSCI World. Energy is also (with financials) the only sector making new all-time highs. Better yet, the outperformance of energy stocks has occurred when all other equity sectors struggled, i.e. in early 2022 when the Russia-Ukraine war started, or this March when the US and Israel started bombing Iran... (see Energy Stocks, If Only As A Hedge). While energy stocks rose during periods of market turbulence, OECD government bonds fell; thereby highlighting that, in our new inflationary world, energy stocks are now a better “antifragile” portfolio buffer than government bonds.
